grammar.summary: 本课学习现在完成时与时间状语搭配，含 ever/just 的用法。

points.title: 现在完成时疑问与 ever
points.explanation: 疑问 Have you ever been to...? 问"是否去过"（人生经历），肯定回答 Yes, I have. 否定 No, I haven't.。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?

points.title: just 表"刚刚"
points.explanation: just 放 have/has 与过去分词之间：I've just been to the cinema. 强调动作刚结束。

examples.en: The weather's always beautiful in spring.
